name: Gir
feeding_notes: Green fodder (Napier grass, Sorghum), Mineral mixture, 3kg concentrates
description: World-renowned A2 milk indigenous breed with high butterfat content (4.5-5%).
key_features: ["Rounded convex forehead", "Long pendulous floppy ears", "Deep red to speckled white coat"]

name: Sahiwal
feeding_notes: Leguminous fodder, Silage, Wheat straw, 4kg dairy meal daily
description: Highest milk producing indigenous cattle breed in South Asia with heavy dewlap and calm demeanor.
key_features: ["Heavy reddish brown build", "Loose skin & heavy dewlap", "Stout horns"]

name: Red Sindhi
description: Deep red compact dairy breed highly adaptable to humid and tropical climates.
key_features: ["Deep dark red coat", "Compact muscular body", "Short thick horns"]

name: Tharparkar
feeding_notes: Dry fodder, Mustard cake, Shrubs & local grasses
description: Dual purpose desert breed known for turning white in extreme summer sun.
key_features: ["White to light grey coat", "Lyre shaped curved horns", "Medium build"]

name: Kankrej
feeding_notes: Coarse fodder, Agricultural byproducts, Green sorghum
description: One of the heaviest Indian breeds famous for its peculiar fast gait ('Sawai Chal').
key_features: ["Massive lyre-shaped horns", "Silver grey to iron grey coat", "Prominent hump"]

name: Ongole
feeding_notes: Paddy straw, Green maize, Protein oil cakes
description: World-class heavy draught & milk breed resistant to tropical diseases and ticks.
key_features: ["Glossy white coat", "Large muscular hump", "Short stumpy horns"]

name: Hallikar
feeding_notes: Dry ragi straw, Green fodder, Mineral blocks
description: Premier draught breed of South India with characteristic backward sweeping sharp horns.
key_features: ["Long vertical backward horns", "Compact grey coat", "Agile athletic frame"]

name: Hariana
feeding_notes: Wheat straw, Bajra, Green clover, Cottonseed cake
description: Popular dual-purpose breed widely reared across North Indian plains.
key_features: ["White to light grey coat", "Small upright face & ears", "Short horns"]

name: Kangayam
description: Resilient South Indian draught breed adapted to dry red soils and tough terrain.
key_features: ["Grey coat with black markings", "Short sharp horns", "Strong legs"]

name: Murrah
feeding_notes: Green berseem, Mustard cake, Wheat straw, 5kg high-protein dairy feed
description: Undisputed 'Black Gold' of Indian dairy sector. World's highest milk producing buffalo breed with 7-8% butterfat.
key_features: ["Jet black body color", "Tightly curled ring horns", "Short white switch tail"]

name: Nili-Ravi
description: Famous 'Panj Kalyan' (five white markings) buffalo known for high fat milk & docility.
key_features: ["Wall eyes (white iris)", "White star on forehead", "White markings on muzzle & legs"]

name: Jaffarabadi
feeding_notes: Sugarcane tops, Napier grass, Cottonseed cake
description: Massive heavy buffalo breed yielding very rich milk (8-10% fat).
key_features: ["Heavy drooping broad horns", "Massive wide forehead", "Deep heavy ribcage"]

name: Surti
feeding_notes: Green forage, Grain mixture 3kg, Mineral salt
description: Medium sized economical buffalo breed with sickle-shaped horns.
key_features: ["Sickle shaped horns", "Two white collars on neck", "Straight back"]

name: Mehsana
description: High yielding dairy breed derived from Murrah and Surti crossbreeding.

name: Banni
feeding_notes: Night grazing on native halophytic grasses, Acacia pods
description: Famous night-grazing desert buffalo capable of walking up to 15km daily.
key_features: ["Coiled inverted horns", "Robust black coat", "High endurance feet"]
